subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Test Design and Time Pressure
description: One-minute skill: Test Design and Time Pressure.

hook.text: Release is tomorrow. You have two hours to design tests. You need the technique that gives the most coverage fastest.

buildup.text: Under time pressure, start with risk-based selection: test the highest-risk features with the simplest technique.

discovery.text: Equivalence partitioning and boundary analysis are the fastest formal techniques—quick to design, high bug yield.

twist.text: Skipping test design entirely under pressure leads to random clicking—which finds few bugs and can't be repeated.

climax.text: Even 30 minutes of structured test design outperforms hours of unplanned testing in bug detection.

punchline.text: No time for everything? Design smart, not random.

quiz.question: Which techniques are fastest to apply under time pressure?
